Button.name: Button
Button.description: Certified interactive action element with 48px touch target and brand corner radius.
rules: TDS-TOUCH-TARGET-TOO-SMALL: Must satisfy min 48x48px touch target.
Button.humanNotes: Use variant='primary' for the single primary call to action per view.

ButtonPure.name: ButtonPure
ButtonPure.description: Minimal text-only or icon button without container background, with optional underline and active highlight.
rules: Use for understated actions, inline triggers, or dialog dismissals.

Link.name: Link
Link.description: Primary or secondary navigational link styled with button-like appearance or link pill.
rules: Use Link for navigation between URLs; use Button for in-page actions.

LinkPure.name: LinkPure
LinkPure.description: Pure text link with optional icon and animated hover underline.
rules: Ideal for card actions, inline references, and resource links.

LinkTile.name: LinkTile
LinkTile.description: High-impact visual card tile combining media, gradient overlay, title, and link navigation.
rules: Enclose media inside LinkTile and pass label as descriptive text.

LinkTileProduct.name: LinkTileProduct
LinkTileProduct.description: E-commerce product card tile displaying price, original price, description, and wishlist action.
rules: Must format price according to locale.

Display.name: Display
Display.description: Massive stage display typography for hero headers and splash showcases.

a11y.headingOrder: Match tag to semantic document hierarchy (h1-h6)

rules: Never use display typography for body text.
examples: <Display tag="h1" size="medium">Autonomous Design Systems for AI Agents.</Display>

Heading.name: Heading
Heading.description: Standard section and screen heading component.
rules: Headings must use sentence case.
examples: <Heading tag="h2" size="xl" weight="semibold">Component Library & Token Architecture</Heading>

Text.name: Text
Text.description: General interface body text, captions, and disclaimers.
rules: Use contrast-high for readability on light or dark surfaces.
examples: <Text size="small" color="contrast-high">Streamline design tokens and component extraction directly from code.</Text>
<Text size="xx-small" color="contrast-low">Certified against WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards.</Text>

Icon.name: Icon

Tag.name: Tag
Tag.description: Categorical badge or chip used for status, attributes, and categorical metadata.
rules: Keep labels brief and clear.

TagDismissible.name: TagDismissible
TagDismissible.description: Interactive filter chip with dismiss action.
rules: Emit dismissal event on click.

Modal.name: Modal
Modal.description: Dialog overlay with frosted backdrop scrim and focus trapping.
rules: Ensure escape key closes the modal.
examples:
<Modal open={true} heading="Privacy Settings">
  <Text>Manage your application preferences and permissions.</Text>
</Modal>

Flyout.name: Flyout
Flyout.description: Slide-out panel drawer anchored to start, end, top, or bottom.
rules: Use for mobile navigation, filter panels, and configuration drawers.

Accordion.name: Accordion
Accordion.description: Collapsible disclosure section for FAQs and technical specifications.
rules: Always use semantic heading tags inside.
examples:
<Accordion heading="Technical Specifications" headingTag="h3">
  <Text>Built with zero runtime dependencies and 100% WCAG AA compliance.</Text>
</Accordion>

Divider.name: Divider
Divider.description: 1px subtle boundary divider between layout blocks.
rules: Do not use heavy contrasting borders where a divider suffices.

Table.name: Table
Table.description: Data table container with sticky header support and responsive scrolling.
rules: Include descriptive caption.

InputSearch.name: InputSearch
InputSearch.description: Interactive search input with search glyph, clear button, and autocomplete support.
rules: Always provide accessible label even if visually hidden.
examples: <InputSearch label="Search documentation" placeholder="Search tokens or components..." clear={true} />

TextField.name: TextField
TextField.description: Text input with 56px height, floating label, and active brand indicator.
rules: TDS-TOUCH-TARGET-TOO-SMALL: Must be at least 56px in height.

Textarea.name: Textarea
Textarea.description: Multi-line text input with character counter and auto-resizing.
rules: Clearly state max character length.

Select.name: Select
Select.description: Dropdown selection control with custom chevron indicator.
rules: Group complex choices using optgroup.

MultiSelect.name: MultiSelect
MultiSelect.description: Multi-item selection control with checkbox dropdown.
rules: Displays selected count or pill summary.

PinCode.name: PinCode
PinCode.description: Discrete digit input boxes for 2FA and verification codes.
rules: Automatically focus next field upon input.

Checkbox.name: Checkbox
Checkbox.description: Form checkbox with indeterminate state and touch target area.
rules: Always wrap within 48x48px hit area.
examples: <Checkbox label="I accept the terms and conditions" />

RadioButton.name: RadioButton
RadioButton.description: Single-choice radio selection control with 48x48px touch target.
rules: Group inside fieldset with common name.

Switch.name: Switch
Switch.description: Toggle switch for binary settings and preferences.
rules: Use for instant state changes without form submission.

SegmentedControl.name: SegmentedControl
SegmentedControl.description: Mutually exclusive pill selector for switching modes or views.
rules: Keep segments to 2-5 options maximum.

Tabs.name: Tabs
Tabs.description: Tabbed content navigation switching between views.
rules: Include matching tab panels.

TabsBar.name: TabsBar
TabsBar.description: Header navigation tab bar without embedded content panels.
rules: Synchronize active index with route changes.

Pagination.name: Pagination
Pagination.description: Multi-page navigation controls with previous, next, and numbered page jumps.
rules: Provide localized labels for accessibility.

Scroller.name: Scroller
Scroller.description: Horizontal carousel / content scroller with scroll indicators and snap points.
rules: Support keyboard horizontal scroll.

Banner.name: Banner
Banner.description: Prominent top banner for site-wide announcements, recalls, or promotions.
rules: Include dismiss button when dismissible.
examples: <Banner state="info" heading="New Feature Available" description="Explore the multi-modal ingestion pipeline." />

InlineNotification.name: InlineNotification
InlineNotification.description: In-context message box indicating status, error, warning, or action required.
rules: Use appropriate state color icon.
examples: <InlineNotification state="warning" heading="Session Expiring" description="Your session will expire in 5 minutes." />

Spinner.name: Spinner
rules: Always provide accessible description.

Toast.name: Toast
Toast.description: Transient notification toast appearing in screen corner.
rules: Auto-dismiss within 4-6 seconds.

Popover.name: Popover
Popover.description: Contextual floating tooltip / popover triggered on click or hover.
rules: Dismiss on escape key or outside click.
examples:
<Popover description="Detailed explanation of token inheritance">
  <ButtonPure icon="information">Info</ButtonPure>
</Popover>

StepperHorizontal.name: StepperHorizontal
StepperHorizontal.description: Step-by-step progress indicator for configuration flows and checkout.
rules: Indicate completed, active, and upcoming steps.

Logo.name: Logo
Logo.description: Authoritative brand logo emblem and vector symbol.
rules: Do not alter colors or aspect ratio.

Wordmark.name: Wordmark
rules: Never re-type brand name with standard fonts; always use Wordmark primitive.

BrandSignature.name: BrandSignature
BrandSignature.description: Sub-brand or product line signature typographic element.
rules: Use brand-specific signature rather than regular text.

Canvas.name: Canvas
Canvas.description: Root layout shell component providing sidebars, navigation slots, and safe zones.
rules: Enforces system safe-zone padding.

Fieldset.name: Fieldset
Fieldset.description: Accessible semantic container grouping related form inputs.
rules: Provide descriptive legend/label.

Card.name: Card
Card.description: Structural content container implementing tonal surface elevation.
rules: TDS-RAW-COLOR: Background must map to surface container tokens.

Badge.name: Badge

Chip.name: Chip
Chip.description: Filter and selection chip with interactive toggle state.
